mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PUSH_TOKEN (EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN, FARM_NUM, DEVICE_ID, PLATFORM, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{expoPushToken}, #{farmNum}, #{deviceId}, #{platform}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE PUSH_TOKEN SET FARM_NUM = #{farmNum}, DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId}, PLATFORM = #{platform}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN = #{expoPushToken}
mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN_ID as tokenId, EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN as expoPushToken, FARM_NUM as farmNum, DEVICE_ID as deviceId, PLATFORM as platform, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM PUSH_TOKEN WHERE EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN = #{expoPushToken}

SELECT TOKEN_ID as tokenId, EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN as expoPushToken, FARM_NUM as farmNum, DEVICE_ID as deviceId, PLATFORM as platform, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM PUSH_TOKEN WHERE FARM_NUM = #{farmNum} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT TOKEN_ID as tokenId, EXPO_PUSH_TOKEN as expoPushToken, FARM_NUM as farmNum, DEVICE_ID as deviceId, PLATFORM as platform, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM PUSH_TOKEN WHERE DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId}
